title: D-OS-4 & D-OS-5: OS-neutral service installer/uninstall parity and Windows ACL permission parity
goal: Align Windows scheduled task run level to Limited (/RL LIMITED), add cross-platform service uninstall command rendering and wire Windows scheduled task cleanup in susi uninstall (OSN-13, OSN-18), enforce Windows owner-only ACLs on plane-bus secret files, and implement Windows secret-file ACL exfiltration risk scanning in runtime_admin.
